posts.title: QSO in a Kilo(gram)
posts.description: I carry an HF ham radio with me most places I go, plus all the equipment that I need to make a contact (a “QSO”). I gave myself a budget of 1 kilogram, so that I’d come up with something that was comfortable to carry with me. I want to be able to operate, including “activating” parks for POTA, spontaneously. I’m primarily a low-power (“QRP”) Morse code (“CW”) operator. This made my task easier.

posts.description: Morse code is suprisingly (to me!) fun. Want to learn?

posts.title: Advice from my first year of learning Morse code
posts.description: Learning Morse code has been a good struggle for me this past year. I’ve averaged somewhere between half an hour and an hour per day of drill for the whole year, and taken only a few days off here and there. (This is more than most people need. I’ve had to work through some early mistakes.)
